in_marathi.name: Vithal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Five Elements
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vithal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vithal is a name of the Hindu god Vishnu, who is the preserver in the Hindu trinity. Vithal is also known as 'Vithobha' or 'Vithoba', and is particularly revered in Maharashtra, India. Vithal is considered to be the Lord of the Five Elements, and is often depicted holding a chakra (discus) and a conch shell. He is also believed to be the giver of power, strength, and healing.
